plugin.name: strata-shell
plugin._long: GTK app extras, and hands each app's menus to Topline.

option.name: global_menus
option._long: Tell GTK apps that the menu bar at the top of the screen shows their menus, so they leave them out of their windows.

option.name: command_key
option._long: Super with a key does in apps what Ctrl with it does (Ctrl+Shift in a terminal); Super+Left/Right/Up/Down and Alt+Left/Right/Backspace move through text as on a Mac.

option.name: command_key_terminals
option._long: App ids, separated by spaces, that are told Ctrl+Shift for Super, so Super+C copies.
option.default: foot footclient org.codeberg.dnkl.foot kitty Alacritty org.gnome.Terminal org.gnome.Console org.gnome.Ptyxis com.mitchellh.ghostty org.wezfurlong.wezterm xterm

option.name: quit_app
option._long: Close every window of the focused app.

option.name: hide_app
option._long: Minimize every window of the focused app.

option.name: hide_others
option._long: Minimize the windows of every other app.

option.name: next_app_window
option._long: Bring the focused app's next window to the front.

option.name: prev_app_window
option._long: Bring the focused app's previous window to the front.
